title: Silas is hungry

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Gonna need yah to move, k? Got something a little bigger than fuses going on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gonna need yah to move, k? Got something a little bigger than fuses going on.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: It's called a hint. Can't take it? I'm a contractor for DataSynth's Comm's division. Trying to install these relays to boost signal across the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's called a hint. Can't take it? I'm a contractor for DataSynth's Comm's division. Trying to install these relays to boost signal across the city.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Have you been getting pings from anyone other than your Automata? They've been down for a scalding hot second. You seemed smarter when you were dealing with the lights.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you been getting pings from anyone other than your Automata? They've been down for a scalding hot second. You seemed smarter when you were dealing with the lights.
MOVE!

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Prolly some punks tryna fuck with the network. Idiots think destruction equals activation. They don't understand how this all works.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Prolly some punks tryna fuck with the network. Idiots think destruction equals activation. They don't understand how this all works.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Didn't hear it from me... Inside job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't hear it from me... Inside job.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Get outta my way so I can keep working.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get outta my way so I can keep working.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: You know what? I actually could use something. Been sluggin overtime and haven't had a chance to eat in hours. Pick me up something. I'll give you a few Lims for it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what? I actually could use something. Been sluggin overtime and haven't had a chance to eat in hours. Pick me up something. I'll give you a few Lims for it.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Anything. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste. It's the consistency.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste. It's the consistency.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: Hmm. Don't mind if I do. Thanks. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste, it's the consistency.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. Don't mind if I do. Thanks. Just no mushrooms. It's not the taste, it's the consistency.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: At this point I'm too hungry to think about it. Any chance you could do me a solid and pick some grub up or something? I'll give yah the Lims for it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At this point I'm too hungry to think about it. Any chance you could do me a solid and pick some grub up or something? I'll give yah the Lims for it.

nodes.speaker: Silas Rhodes
nodes.text: You moving? Oh I don't know, maybe let me finish my work? Finish my job. Complete my contract. Get paid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You moving? Oh I don't know, maybe let me finish my work? Finish my job. Complete my contract. Get paid.
What are you doing?
Thought the Comms were down?
What will that do?
Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything I can do to help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything I can do to help?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything I can do to help?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything I can do to help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think happened?
If you say so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sure you don't need anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure you don't need anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You sure you don't need anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You sure you don't need anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Keep the Lims. I own a place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Keep the Lims. I own a place.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Keep the Lims. I own a place.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Keep the Lims. I own a place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds good.
They do not.
Maybe change is good.
I could see that.
No way.
